evidence.method: NDVI=(NIR-red)/(NIR+red), per-asset reflectance scale/offset; cloud-filtered paired pixels. Slope computed on a 30 m projected elevation grid.
evidence.limitations: Exploratory thresholds, not validated for Taiwan. Seasonal changes, agriculture and image misalignment can cause vegetation loss signals. An older landslide may show no new loss. Flat runout deposits can fail the slope check. Copernicus DEM is a surface model including vegetation/buildings, not current bare-earth terrain. Missing evidence is not negative evidence.

roads.method: Shortest projected distance from candidate polygon edge/interior to mapped road centerline. Zero means geometric intersection.
roads.limitations: Proximity is not a blockage, impact or safety assessment. Road widths, access, current conditions and landslide runout are not modeled. OSM may omit roads; road data dates differ from satellite dates. Tracks are included; footpaths are excluded.

preprocessing: 11 L2A reflectance bands + slope degrees + DEM metres; frozen pilot normalization; native 128-pixel windows at 10 m; overlapping probability blend; eroded SCL 4/5 clear land only

calibration.preprocessing: 11 L2A reflectance bands + slope degrees + DEM metres; frozen pilot normalization; native 128-pixel windows at 10 m; overlapping probability blend; eroded SCL 4/5 clear land only
calibration.threshold_basis: Pilot validation; not a calibrated landslide risk probability
calibration.evaluation_note: 24 inventory-labelled test patches across three regions; repeatedly compared during development. Live-image accuracy is unmeasured.

limitations: Experimental Taiwan inventory-trained U-Net. Historical inventory holdout performance does not measure accuracy on this live scene. Terrain is also a model input, so slope is supporting context, not independent validation. Candidates can be bare soil, roads or riverbeds; human review required. Coordinates are derived from imagery, not survey-accurate. A single scene cannot establish event timing.
attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data and Copernicus DEM; distributed through Element 84 Earth Search / AWS. Copernicus DEM accessed 2026-11-15 from https://registry.opendata.aws/copernicus-dem/.

weather.limitations: Weather-model forecasts, not observations or landslide probabilities. Regional samples can miss mountain rainfall extremes. Old satellite scars do not establish current slope condition. Follow official Taiwan warnings for safety decisions.
weather.summary: Forecast precipitation over the next 24 hours: 12–17.1 mm across 5 available sample locations. Highest forecast hourly precipitation among samples: 1.9 mm. This is rainfall context, not a prediction that a particular slope will fail.
